summary: Frontend-only verification of per-theme flourish matrix + Coffee Shop dust motes ambience for Fork·Fate. Ran ZIP=90210 deal for 10 themes [winter,spring,fall,tiki,summer,light,fantasy,steam,dark,cyber] in a single browser context (localStorage seeded via add_init_script; guided skipped via [data-testid=guided-skip]). Polled [data-testid=deck-flourish] every 100ms during shuffle window and [data-testid=theme-flourish]/[data-testid=steam-burst] during reveal. All 10 themes behaved exactly as specified. No console errors observed on any theme.
critical_code_review_comments: ThemeFlourish.jsx correctly gates fantasy from deck variant (line 182) and re-uses SteamBurst for both 'steam' and 'light' — clean unification.
CafeDustMotes uses `fixed inset-0 z-0` with pointer-events-none — verified deal button remained clickable while motes were mounted (light theme deal fired successfully).
Minor: FLOURISH_THEMES exported from ThemeFlourish.jsx is imported in RevealStage to gate the steaming effect — ensure any future theme addition updates the Set in one place only (currently correct).
seed_data_creation: localStorage per theme: ff_theme=<theme>, ff_theme_chosen=1, ff_theme_hint_seen=1, ff_deal_taps=0, ff_rare_at=10, ff_muted=1 (ff_rare_force cleared).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Poll [data-testid=deck-flourish] every ~100ms up to 8s after clicking [data-testid=spin-roulette-button] — the landed moment is short (~1.5-2s). Reveal flourish auto-unmounts around 4.2s so poll immediately after reveal-photo-header mounts. Fantasy is a special case: no deck-flourish (dragon-claw-overlay + fantasy-gold-pulse instead), but reveal DOES render theme-flourish with data-flourish=fantasy (FireWall).

light.extras: cafe-dust-motes present on load; deal button clickable

fantasy.extras: dragon-claw-overlay + fantasy-gold-pulse both present on landing
